טבלה: פוליסת ביטוח ימי ליאכטות וסירות
This table details coverage for marine insurance policies for yachts and boats from Shirbit. It outlines covered losses or damages, such as those caused by accidents, explosions, or theft.
ממדים: Types of loss or damage covered under the insurance policy, Conditions and specifics of coverage
